gpu_restore_dependency_wait.semantics: Sampled CUDA-stream native layer-dependency waits including event overhead; not all H2D, not request queue delay or an oracle JCT bound.

worker_interval_neighbors.launch_timestamp_semantics: scheduler.run_batch entry before telemetry and worker dispatch, not CUDA submission or kernel start. Only explicitly recorded raw timestamps are used; legacy service starts are not substituted.
worker_interval_neighbors.semantics: Consecutive observed worker intervals in processed-completion order. The exported service start is clipped to the previous processed completion, so it is not a raw batch launch. A zero neighboring boundary gap follows from that clipping; it does not prove zero result-processing cost. These fields cannot split kernel, scheduling or overlap time. Cohorts match current native work/context geometry and the following observed phase/batch size, not identical work. Missing geometry or timestamps remain unknown; unobserved native batches may exist.

background_writer_timing.semantics: Measured processing samples completed between writer snapshots. Producer timestamps, queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Samples may span a boundary; cumulative maxima are not window maxima. No multiplication by the sampling interval, full-window cost, GIL attribution, GPU stall or JCT saving is inferred.

geometry.cuda_graph_semantics: Engine completion result can_run_cuda_graph, paired with this batch. Absent legacy flags remain unknown; batch size alone does not prove replay. Worker intervals include scheduler/result processing and are not kernel timings.

prefill_geometry.semantics: Completed worker intervals, not CUDA kernel timings. Cohorts require native prepared prefix/extend lengths for every batch row; they match batch size, 512-token total-work bins and 2048-token mean-prefix bins. Legacy missing fields or zero defaults do not establish zero prefill work. Partial attributed batches retain unknown total work.

client_pressure.semantics: Distributions of existing samples, not time-weighted occupancy, unique working-set size, exposed GPU stalls or removable workflow time.

semantics: Completed-window historical development comparison, not a matched causal trial.
Decode bins match batch size and 2048-token mean context; graph bins additionally retain the actual per-batch replay flag, including unknown.
Prefill bins require native work for every row and match batch size, 512-token total work and 2048-token mean prefix; they are not identical requests or kernel timings.
Pressure and reclaim counters use existing sampled telemetry; missing values remain unknown and are not zero.

Host occupancy includes host_pool_usage records only; eviction records in the same stream are not occupancy samples. Client num_used_tokens/resident_pressure are reported activity gauges, not all allocated or evictable HBM pages.
The geometry reader hashes the exact complete-line prefix it consumed through verified window coverage. Other JSONL streams use stat-bounded complete-line prefixes. Cross-file reads are not atomic.
The service basis supplies transfer receipts. Physical transfer time, worker interval, queue time and reclamation counts do not by themselves establish removable JCT or mechanism causality.
